description: Maybach Ultimate Luxury is an iconic Mercedes-branded residential development by Binghatti, located in the prestigious Meydan district. The project features two striking towers, each comprising a basement level, ground floor, mezzanine, five podium levels, and an elegant residential structure - with nineteen floors in Tower A and twenty-five in Tower B. Designed to embody sophistication and architectural excellence, the complex stands as a symbol of branded luxury living in Dubai. The development offers a refined selection of studios and one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to suit both homeowners and investors. Interiors showcase a contemporary aesthetic defined by clean architectural lines, premium materials, rich textures, and a warm, elegant color palette. Every detail is curated to reflect understated luxury and timeless style. Residents are treated to an exceptional array of lifestyle amenities, including a stunning infinity swimming pool, a shared jacuzzi, and dedicated outdoor yoga spaces. The development also features beautifully designed leisure and relaxation areas, premium beauty salons, diverse dining outlets, and well-equipped sports facilities. Complemented by valet parking and professional concierge services, every detail is thoughtfully curated to provide comfort, convenience, and elevated everyday living. The residential component features a refined collection of luxury towers designed to reflect the innovation, performance, and sophistication associated with the Mercedes-Benz brand. Homes are envisioned as contemporary urban sanctuaries, offering elegant layouts, expansive views, and a strong connection to the surrounding cityscape. Premium materials, meticulous detailing, and high-quality finishes define both interiors and common areas, creating a living environment where luxury, precision, and timeless design converge. Location description and benefits Meydan is one of Dubai's most ambitious and prestigious districts, designed as a contemporary urban destination where luxury, nature, and innovation converge. Known for its expansive open spaces and iconic skyline views, the area blends modern residential developments with landscaped parks, waterways, and cultural landmarks. Meydan's master-planned environment offers a sense of scale, openness, and refinement rarely found in central urban locations. The district is internationally recognized for Meydan Racecourse, a world-class equestrian and sporting venue that hosts prestigious global events and anchors the area's elite identity. Surrounding the racecourse are premium residential communities, leisure destinations, retail concepts, and wellness-focused spaces, all thoughtfully integrated to support a high-quality lifestyle. Wide boulevards, pedestrian-friendly planning, and scenic vistas define the everyday experience in Meydan. Strategically located with excellent connectivity to Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport, Meydan offers both lifestyle appeal and strong investment potential. Its limited land availability, ongoing development momentum, and growing demand for branded and luxury residences position Meydan as a prime destination for end-users and investors seeking long-term value in one of Dubai's most forward-looking districts.

title: Dubai Industrial City, Dubai
description: Mirari Lagoon by Zoya Developments presents a thoughtfully designed collection of studio, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom apartments, bringing together contemporary architecture, elegant interiors, and resort-inspired living. Located in Dubai Industrial City, the development offers fully furnished residences designed to provide comfort, functionality, and modern convenience. With stylish layouts and carefully planned living spaces, each residence creates a welcoming environment for individuals, couples, and families seeking a contemporary home in Dubai. The development offers a range of lifestyle amenities designed to support relaxation, wellness, and recreation. Residents can enjoy a lagoon-inspired swimming pool, infinity pool, fully equipped fitness centre, jogging track, poolside cabanas, and landscaped outdoor spaces. Dedicated leisure and relaxation areas create opportunities to unwind, enjoy outdoor activities, and experience a resort-style atmosphere within the residential community. Mirari Lagoon combines modern residential comfort with a leisure-focused lifestyle, creating an environment where everyday living is complemented by recreational facilities and thoughtfully designed surroundings. Its fully furnished apartments, contemporary design, and selection of lifestyle amenities make the development an appealing choice for both homeowners and investors looking for a modern residential property in Dubai. With its location in Dubai Industrial City, Mirari Lagoon offers connectivity to key destinations across Dubai. Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai are approximately 10 minutes away, while Palm Jebel Ali is around 20 minutes away. Dubai Marina and Downtown Dubai are also accessible by road, offering residents convenient access to shopping, entertainment, business, and leisure destinations. The project features studio apartments starting from approximately AED 565,000, 1-bedroom apartments from AED 899,000, and 2-bedroom apartments from AED 1,127,000. Buyers can benefit from an advertised flexible payment plan of 20% on booking, 28% during construction, 10% on handover, and 42% post-handover over 60 months. With its fully furnished residences, resort-inspired amenities, and flexible payment structure, Mirari Lagoon presents an attractive opportunity for those looking to own a home or explore property investment in Dubai. Location Description & Benefits Dubai Industrial City is an established industrial and commercial destination within the wider Dubai South region, offering connectivity to important transport, logistics, and business hubs. Its strategic position makes it an emerging location for residential developments, particularly for professionals and residents seeking convenient access to employment and infrastructure. The surrounding area benefits from its proximity to Al Maktoum International Airport, Expo City Dubai, and major road networks connecting different parts of the emirate. These destinations contribute to the area's long-term development potential and accessibility. Residents can also reach shopping, dining, entertainment, and everyday facilities across nearby communities. With its growing infrastructure, strategic connectivity, and proximity to major development zones in southern Dubai, Dubai Industrial City offers an interesting residential and investment location. Mirari Lagoon brings together modern furnished apartments, leisure facilities, and convenient access to key destinations, creating a contemporary living option within this developing part of Dubai.

title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: Azizi Milan by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential destination in City of Arabia, Dubailand, inspired by the timeless elegance of Italian architecture and design. Drawing inspiration from Milan's renowned Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, the development blends distinctive architectural character with modern urban living. Its residential collection includes studios and 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully planned to maximise functionality, natural light, and everyday comfort. Floor-to-ceiling windows and contemporary layouts create bright, inviting interiors suited to both homeowners and property investors. Amenities and lifestyle Designed to bring resort-inspired living into an urban setting, Azizi Milan offers an extensive selection of more than 30 amenities. Residents can enjoy a state-of-the-art gym, swimming pools, landscaped gardens, and dedicated children's play areas, alongside convenient retail outlets and dining options within the community. One of the development's standout features is its expansive crystal-clear lagoon, creating a striking waterfront atmosphere and adding a leisure-focused dimension to everyday living. Combined with recreational facilities and community spaces, these amenities offer opportunities for relaxation, fitness, and social connection. Finishes and interiors The residences feature modern interiors, quality materials, and practical layouts that balance contemporary style with functionality. Large windows allow natural light to fill the living spaces, while the clean, modern aesthetic provides a versatile foundation for personalisation. Kitchen and appliances Equipped kitchens designed to provide everyday convenience and functionality. Furnishing Unfurnished, giving residents the flexibility to personalise their homes according to their preferences. Location and lifestyle Located in City of Arabia within Dubailand, Azizi Milan is part of a planned mixed-use destination designed to bring residential living, retail, entertainment, and leisure together. The wider area is envisioned as a vibrant urban community with a diverse range of residential options and lifestyle facilities. City of Arabia is associated with major planned attractions, including Mall of Arabia and the Restless Planet theme park concept. As development progresses, the wider district aims to offer a blend of shopping, dining, family entertainment, and recreational spaces within a connected community environment. Dubailand provides access to several established residential neighbourhoods and leisure destinations across Dubai. Road connections link the area with other parts of the city, making it a location to consider for residents seeking a contemporary home away from the busiest central districts. Combining Italian-inspired design, a broad range of amenities, and a lagoon-centred lifestyle, Azizi Milan offers a distinctive residential concept for buyers looking for modern living and potential investment opportunities in Dubailand.

description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

title: Dubai Islands, Dubai
description: Isla Private Residences is a boutique waterfront development on Dubai Islands by Chaimaa Holding, conceived around the philosophy of Dolce Far Niente - the art of refined, intentional living. The project comprises an exclusive collection of 76 one-, two-, and three-bedroom residences, defined by sculptural architecture, flowing terraces, and expansive glazing that frames open sea and skyline views. The building's elegant curves, landscaped podium, and expressive rooftop silhouette create a distinctive presence within the coastal destination of Dubai Islands. The development offers 32 amenities curated across three dedicated lifestyle levels, thoughtfully divided into family, wellness, social, and entertainment experiences. Highlights include a Sanctuary Pool and dedicated children's splash areas, a salt sauna and cold plunge pool for contrast therapy, and a rooftop infinity pool overlooking the sea. Social spaces extend beyond traditional lounges, featuring asunken seating with a fireplace, communal dining terraces, and an outdoor cinema. A rooftop sports lounge and bar, secret garden zones, yoga terraces, and a dedicated entertainment lounge for teens and young adults add a distinctive layer of community-focused living rarely seen in boutique projects on Dubai Islands. Interiors are designed with an emphasis on light, proportion, and refined materiality. Floor-to-ceiling windows enhance openness and natural illumination, while contemporary kitchens integrate premium appliances and generous worktops to balance aesthetics with practicality. Bathrooms are conceived as spa-inspired environments, featuring upscale fittings and sophisticated materials that elevate everyday rituals. Each residence includes dedicated utility areas and private balconies, reinforcing seamless indoor-outdoor living and a sense of tranquil coastal retreat. Location description and benefits Dubai Islands is a visionary development that epitomizes the luxurious and innovative spirit of Dubai. Strategically located along the coast, this ambitious project features a collection of five man-made islands designed to offer a blend of residential, commercial, and leisure spaces. Each island is meticulously planned to provide a unique living experience, surrounded by pristine beaches, lush landscapes, and crystal-clear waters. The islands are connected to the mainland via well-developed infrastructure, ensuring seamless access to the rest of the city. This prime location allows residents and visitors to enjoy the tranquility of island life while being just a short drive away from Dubai's bustling urban centers, including the iconic landmarks and vibrant districts such as Downtown Dubai, Dubai Marina, and Palm Jumeirah. The development includes a range of upscale amenities, including luxury hotels, gourmet dining options, high-end retail outlets, and world-class recreational facilities. Dubai Islands is designed to cater to a diverse array of lifestyles, offering everything from serene residential communities to dynamic entertainment hubs. The project emphasizes sustainability and innovation, incorporating green building practices and advanced technologies to create a harmonious and eco-friendly environment. With its stunning natural beauty, exceptional amenities, and strategic location, Dubai Islands stands as a premier destination for those seeking an unparalleled lifestyle in one of the world's most dynamic cities.

description: Rosehill presents a thoughtfully designed collection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, where contemporary architecture meets the tranquillity of nature. Each residence is designed to maximise natural light, with open layouts, outdoor terraces, and expansive views of the Dubai Hills Golf Course. Surrounded by landscaped gardens and greenery, the development creates a peaceful residential environment that brings indoor comfort and outdoor living together. The community offers an extensive range of lifestyle amenities designed to support wellness, recreation, and social interaction. Residents can enjoy a swimming pool, outdoor gym, padel court, botanical garden, and table tennis zone. Dedicated indoor and outdoor children's play areas provide spaces for younger residents, while peaceful courtyards, landscaped gardens, and communal seating decks offer inviting settings for relaxation and connection. Rosehill combines an active lifestyle with a natural residential setting, creating a community where leisure and wellbeing are part of everyday living. Its landscaped surroundings, recreational facilities, and golf course outlook contribute to an atmosphere of calm and exclusivity. Set within the established Dubai Hills Estate, Rosehill places residents close to a range of lifestyle destinations, including Dubai Hills Mall, Dubai Hills Park, and the championship golf course. The combination of green surroundings, contemporary residences, and convenient access to retail, leisure, and everyday facilities creates a balanced lifestyle for families, professionals, and homeowners seeking a well-connected yet peaceful community. Location Description & Benefits Dubai Hills Estate is a prestigious master-planned community developed by Emaar Properties in collaboration with Meraas. Designed around the concept of green, connected living, the destination brings together contemporary residences, landscaped open spaces, leisure facilities, and retail destinations within an integrated urban environment. At the heart of the community is its 18-hole championship golf course, which adds expansive green views and a sense of tranquillity to the surrounding residential neighbourhoods. Landscaped parks, walking paths, cycling routes, and open recreational spaces further encourage an active outdoor lifestyle. Dubai Hills Mall serves as a major lifestyle and entertainment destination, offering a diverse selection of retail outlets, restaurants, cafés, and family attractions. Dubai Hills Park provides additional outdoor space for recreation, relaxation, and family activities, complementing the community's green surroundings. With its combination of established infrastructure, premium residential developments, retail destinations, and extensive green spaces, Dubai Hills Estate offers a well-rounded lifestyle. Its appeal lies in bringing together the convenience of modern city living with the comfort and tranquillity of a landscaped residential community.

description: Project general facts New Project is an elegant mixed-use residential tower that blends contemporary architecture with a warm, welcoming sense of home. Its refined facade of soft cream stone, bronze-toned vertical fins and gently curved edges gives the building a graceful and instantly recognisable silhouette. Adding to its economic strength is the Jebel Ali Free Zone (JAFZA), a dynamic business and industrial hub that attracts multinational corporations with its favorable environment for growth and innovation. Alongside this commercial power, Jebel Ali features vibrant residential communities with modern amenities, schools, and leisure facilities, offering a balanced lifestyle for its residents. The district also benefits from excellent connectivity, seamlessly linked to the rest of Dubai through Sheikh Zayed Road and the Dubai Metro. title: 58XX+M4, Dubai
description: Creek Haven by Emaar introduces an elevated waterfront lifestyle where contemporary elegance meets the tranquillity of nature. Offering a thoughtfully designed collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, the development combines sophisticated architecture, soothing water views, and abundant natural light to create homes that feel both inviting and refined. Each residence is carefully planned to maximize space, openness, and comfort, with modern interiors defined by clean lines, understated details, and a harmonious palette of soft tones. Generous layouts and expansive views capture the peaceful atmosphere of Dubai Creek Harbour, creating a private retreat where residents can unwind and enjoy a more balanced way of living. The development offers an impressive selection of resort-inspired amenities designed to support wellness, recreation, and social connection. Residents can enjoy separate adult and children's swimming pools, indoor and outdoor fitness facilities, a padel court, dedicated yoga and relaxation areas, children's play spaces, and beautifully landscaped gardens. These thoughtfully curated facilities encourage an active outdoor lifestyle while creating a welcoming community environment. The apartments are offered unfurnished, giving residents the flexibility to personalise their homes according to their individual tastes and preferences. High-quality finishes, contemporary kitchens, refined materials, and carefully considered details provide an elegant foundation for modern living. Blending functionality with understated luxury, Creek Haven creates a living environment designed for comfort and lasting appeal. Location: Dubai Creek Harbour Dubai Creek Harbour is a landmark waterfront destination envisioned as a distinctive blend of contemporary architecture, natural beauty, and urban convenience. Spanning approximately eight square kilometres, this master-planned community combines residential living with leisure, retail, and recreational experiences along the historic Dubai Creek. One of the area's standout attractions is Creek Beach, an urban beach destination featuring approximately 700 metres of white sand, a resort-style atmosphere, and picturesque sunset views. The wider community is designed to offer a family-friendly environment, with landscaped promenades, open spaces, and opportunities to enjoy the waterfront lifestyle. Dubai Creek Harbour is also associated with the ambitious Dubai Creek Tower project, designed by renowned architect Santiago Calatrava. The wider destination reflects Dubai's vision for innovative urban development, bringing together contemporary design, sustainability, and a vibrant waterfront setting. With its scenic surroundings, lifestyle attractions, and thoughtfully planned community infrastructure, Dubai Creek Harbour offers an appealing residential destination for homeowners and investors seeking modern waterfront living in Dubai.

description: Seafront Apartments with Installments on Siniyah Island Siniya Island, located in Umm Al Quwain, is an emerging residential and leisure destination renowned for its tranquil natural beauty and serene island atmosphere. Surrounded by crystal-clear waters and pristine beaches, it provides a unique blend of relaxation and adventure, featuring exclusive residential communities, luxurious amenities, and diverse recreational options such as golfing, water sports, and eco-tourism activities. Its strategic position, away from the city's bustle yet conveniently accessible, makes it an ideal retreat for residents seeking tranquility combined with modern comfort. , are conveniently located just 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. The project offers a luxurious coastal living experience, prominently featuring pristine natural beaches, serene lagoon beaches, and vibrant landscaped parks. Its exterior design is elegantly set along a mesmerizing shoreline with four distinct towers, each with breathtaking views of the turquoise waters and lush greenery. The community is enriched by world-class amenities including an infinity swimming pool, a state-of-the-art fitness center, children's play areas, an outdoor cinema, and a community center. For adventure enthusiasts, thrilling water sports such as snorkeling, scuba diving, and kite surfing are readily available. Additional sophisticated conveniences include an exclusive yacht club, a vibrant retail boulevard with open-air cafés and gourmet dining options, an upscale shopping mall, and luxurious resorts. Connectivity is ensured by a picturesque 1.7 km bridge, providing easy access from the urban landscape to the island's tranquility. The project offers meticulously designed interiors that blend contemporary luxury with practical elegance, available in configurations of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments. Tower A residences are fully furnished, providing immediate comfort and sophisticated style from day one, while Towers B, C, and D are delivered semi-furnished, allowing residents flexibility to personalize their spaces. Each apartment is thoughtfully planned, featuring spacious layouts complemented by premium finishes and fixtures. All units come equipped with fitted wardrobes, providing both functionality and aesthetic appeal, and modern kitchens fitted with high-quality white goods, enhancing convenience and elegance. Expansive windows and private balconies optimize natural lighting and allow residents to enjoy serene views of the surrounding natural landscapes, pristine beaches, and tranquil lagoons. The interiors encapsulate a refined lifestyle, with attention to detail evident in every corner, creating a harmonious environment tailored for ultimate comfort and style. UAQ-00006

Its proximity to Dubai Creek and surrounding waterfront areas adds another dimension to the lifestyle experience, with scenic surroundings and opportunities for leisurely walks. Public transport connections, including nearby metro stations and bus routes, further enhance accessibility to different parts of the city. The neighbourhood continues to evolve through residential development and infrastructure improvements, strengthening its appeal as an established urban destination. Its combination of connectivity, waterfront surroundings, and access to essential amenities supports a convenient and well-connected lifestyle. Dubai Creek Harbour is also known for its ambitious architectural vision and connection to the historic Dubai Creek. Its combination of modern urban planning, waterfront scenery, and access to key destinations makes it attractive to both homeowners and investors seeking a contemporary address in Dubai. title: Majan, Dubai
description: Binghatti Titania at Majan is a high-rise 38-storey ultra-luxury advanced architectural excellence, above the podium levels, developed by leading Binghatti Developers . Laced with premium of the prime designed exclusive edition studios, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments to satisfy your luxury thirst to redefine the lifestyle. Being inspired from the Mythos tale, and rising with sovereign confidence as 3B+G+4P+32 residential floors with mech. and roof floor from the majan corridor. The tower commands immediate bold attention through a distinctive façade defined by a dark, metallic geometric grid that contrasts deliberately and dramatically against expansive glass surface, between structure and transparency that gives the building a rare character. The architectural philosophy extends far beyond its exterior geometry, threading through every interior surface with an equally precise design. The materials palette chose for the residences reads as a consideration curation of natural and refined elements. Patagonia marble in its two distinct expressions brings both dynamic veining and quiet textural richness to kitchen, bathrooms and entrance areas. Oakwood panelling introduces warmth and organic depth to living and bedroom walls; bronze trims add luminous finish detail to joinery and fixtures; and green brushed steel appears as a signature accent that ties the interior palette to the tower's broader identity. Interiors are conceived around open-plan spatial logic, with light treated not as an amenity but as the primary architectural material, its movement through floor-to-ceiling glazing creates a living, breathing quality of illumination across subtle neutral hues that shift from cream and sand to warm ivory across different times. The result is a residential atmosphere that feels simultaneously expansive and intimate, modern and enduring, a place where the design draws back deliberately to place the resident and their sense of stillness at the centre of every room. The amenity deck has been conceived as a comprehensive lifestyle environment that balances activation and restoration with equal intelligence. The podium level opens into an adult infinity pool and shallow water pool that appear to dissolve into the Dubai skyline beyond as one of the tower's most photogenic and experientially powerful spaces. Families are catered for through a dedicated children's swimming pool paired with an Aqua Joy water splash zone, while the Little Marvels play area provides a curated outdoor environment for younger residents. Wellness is addressed through a yoga zone and a fully equipped gym, and the social dimension of community life is enriched through a floating pergola deck, outdoor seating areas, landscaped walkways, and abundant green spaces that soften the podium's urban edge. Residents also benefit from immediate proximity to Al Barari's cycling tracks and natural reserves, Majan Park, Majan Active Park, and the Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club, a constellation of leisure and green infrastructure. Project Highlights: The tower rises across 32 residential floors with a striking dark metallic geometric façade contrasting bold glass surfaces. A total of 789 residences span studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom apartment configurations across the entire development. Premium interiors feature Patagonia marble, Oakwood panelling, bronze trims, and signature green brushed steel throughout every residence. Residents enjoy direct road access to E311, Sheikh Zayed Road, Umm Suqeim Street, and Dubai-Al Ain Road. Downtown Dubai and Burj Khalifa are reachable within fifteen to twenty-five minutes from the tower's Majan address. The amenity deck features an infinity pool, children's splash zone, yoga area, gym, and landscaped pergola deck.

description: Aeon by Emaar presents a contemporary residential experience where modern urban design meets the tranquillity of waterfront living. Set within the vibrant Dubai Creek Harbour community, the development combines striking architecture, natural surroundings, and captivating city views to create a distinctive address for modern lifestyles. Residents can enjoy picturesque views of Dubai Creek Canal, landscaped parks, and the city's evolving skyline. Inspired by the character of urban architecture, Aeon embraces authentic materials and contemporary design elements, bringing together the essence of Dubai's heritage with its forward-looking architectural vision. Contemporary Residences & Refined Finishes Aeon offers a thoughtfully designed selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences, catering to individuals, couples, and families seeking modern comfort in a waterfront setting. The 1-bedroom apartments feature spacious living areas and urban views, while the larger 2 and 3-bedroom residences offer additional space, contemporary bathrooms, generous storage, and expansive balconies that connect indoor living with the surrounding cityscape. Each residence is designed to balance functionality and modern aesthetics, creating inviting interiors complemented by natural light and scenic views. Kitchen & Furnishing The residences feature equipped kitchens designed to support everyday convenience and contemporary living. Apartments are offered unfurnished, providing residents with the flexibility to personalise their interiors according to their preferences. Prime Location - Dubai Creek Harbour Located adjacent to the central plaza, Aeon enjoys a position within Dubai Creek Harbour, an expansive waterfront destination spanning approximately eight square kilometres. The master-planned community brings together contemporary residences, landscaped open spaces, retail destinations, leisure facilities, and scenic waterfront promenades. Dubai Creek Harbour offers a distinctive lifestyle where urban energy meets natural surroundings. Residents can enjoy outdoor spaces, waterfront walks, dining destinations, and recreational areas within a vibrant residential environment. Creek Beach adds to the community's appeal with approximately 700 metres of white sand, an infinity pool, and picturesque sunset views, creating a relaxed beachside atmosphere within the city. The wider masterplan also features the landmark Dubai Creek Tower, designed by renowned architect Santiago Calatrava, as part of Dubai Creek Harbour's ambitious architectural vision. An Urban Lifestyle Inspired by Nature Aeon by Emaar combines contemporary architecture, spacious residences, and waterfront surroundings within one of Dubai's prominent master-planned communities. With its proximity to landscaped parks, the central plaza, and the attractions of Dubai Creek Harbour, the development offers an appealing setting for residents seeking a balance of modern city living and natural tranquillity. Experience a contemporary waterfront lifestyle where city views, modern design, and nature come together.

description: Exclusive Beachfront Apartments with Installment on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a site of significant historical and ecological importance. This visionary development, developed in partnership with Marjan, Ras Al Khaimah's master developer, offers a stunning collection of fully furnished homes that translate the bold aesthetic of British fashion legend John Richmond into a exquisite residential offering. With a selection of studios, one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and three-bedroom apartments and duplexes, every residence has been meticulously crafted to embody the pinnacle of waterfront luxury. The John Richmond Residences are appointed with the finest details, featuring Italian-made furniture, premium appliances, exquisite lighting, luxurious linens, and complete kitchen equipment and tableware, ensuring that every home is move-in ready and exquisitely finished. Residents enjoy the highest standards of service with five-star hotel-level amenities that anticipate every need and desire, while the comprehensive Mira Care programme provides a five-year warranty on fixtures and a three-year warranty on furniture. This is a place where every detail has been considered, from the bold aesthetic of internationally renowned design to the practical comforts that make a house a home. Beyond the extraordinary John Richmond Residences offers an unparalleled array of amenities that celebrate the waterfront lifestyle in all its glory. Residents enjoy private beach access, a prestigious yacht club, multiple swimming pools, five-star hotels, beach clubs, and an exquisite selection of restaurants, cafés, and retail destinations. The community also features a fitness and wellness centre, beautifully landscaped promenades, and dedicated family spaces, all designed to create a vibrant and enriching environment where life naturally moves towards the water. Location description and benefits Al Mairid in Ras Al Khaimah offers an idyllic coastal setting where the mountains meet the sea, creating a breathtaking backdrop for a lifestyle of unparalleled refinement and natural beauty. This enchanting location provides residents with direct access to pristine private beaches and the sparkling waters of the Arabian Gulf, offering a serene sanctuary that feels a world away from the everyday. The neighbourhood's unspoiled natural beauty and tranquil atmosphere make it the ideal destination for those seeking an escape from the ordinary and an embrace of the extraordinary. Life within Al Mairid is defined by its exceptional balance of peaceful seclusion and convenient accessibility, with Downtown Ras Al Khaimah just minutes away and Al Marjan Island, home to the iconic Wynn resort, within easy reach. The surrounding area is rich with opportunities for exploration and leisure, from the world-class Al Hamra Golf Club to the vibrant cultural and commercial attractions of the emirate. This is a community where every day feels like a holiday, and where the gentle rhythm of the sea provides the soundtrack to a life of timeless elegance. The surroundings of Al Mairid offer unparalleled access to the best that Ras Al Khaimah has to offer, with Ras Al Khaimah International Airport just a short journey away and Dubai within comfortable reach for those seeking the dynamic energy of the metropolis. The area's strategic location and excellent transport links make this coastal haven both accessible and exclusive, offering residents the perfect retreat without sacrificing convenience. This distinguished address truly offers the best of both worlds, combining the serenity of beachfront living with the dynamic allure of one of the region's fastest-growing destinations.

Surrounded by pristine beaches and unspoiled natural beauty, the island offers a serene escape while remaining well-connected to the mainland. title: Dubai South Residential District, Dubai
raw_area: Dubai South Residential District, Dubai, Dubai
description: Project general facts This is a boutique residential building, with a ground floor and four residential floors. Inspired by the idea of composition, the architecture combines warm bronze tones, rounded corners and wide glazed balconies with slim railings, giving the facade a soft, horizontal rhythm. Slatted canopies crown the rooftop, and palm trees and planters soften the edges of the building and its terraces. The compact scale of the project creates a quiet, private atmosphere for residents. Amenities are designed for wellness, leisure and family life. The rooftop features an open swimming pool with sun loungers under a curved slatted canopy, alongside a rooftop lounge with sofas and low tables among landscaped planters. Residents also have a gym with views over the district, an outdoor yoga deck and a barbecue area for gatherings in the open air. Families benefit from a kids' pool and a dedicated kids' play area, while an elegant entrance lobby welcomes residents and guests. The building offers studios and two-bedroom apartments, which suits both single residents and small families. All residences are delivered fully furnished, with refined interiors in soft neutral tones, natural materials and warm lighting. Kitchens and living areas are arranged around natural light, and private balconies extend the living spaces outdoors, while the low-rise, boutique format keeps the building calm and private. Location description and benefits Dubai South Residential District is a master-planned residential area in the south of Dubai, developed around Al Maktoum International Airport and Expo City Dubai. The district combines low-rise residential buildings, green streets, parks and community facilities in a calm suburban setting, and it continues to grow as new homes, schools and retail are added around the airport and the Expo City business area. Road links connect the area with Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, giving access to Jebel Ali, Dubai Investments Park and the rest of the city. The island holds historical significance as the oldest pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf and is home to an ancient Eastern Christian monastery, reflecting its vibrant past. Recent developments aim to transform Siniyah Island into a premier destination, blending luxury living with ecological preservation while maintaining its cultural heritage. Apartments for sale on Siniyah Island, Umm Al Quwain, are conveniently located just 5 minutes from essential services, 10 minutes from Al Marjan Island, 30 minutes from Sharjah, 50 minutes from Downtown Dubai, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport. Its exterior showcases contemporary architectural brilliance seamlessly integrated with serene sea views, sun-drenched promenades, and a dynamic marina. The residences boast direct access to a motorized seawater body, a yacht club with mooring facilities, and a lively promenade enriched by fine dining, boutique cafés, and vibrant nightlife. Residents enjoy podium-level infinity pools, cutting-edge fitness centers with marina views, cozy lounges, and engaging outdoor play zones. Expansive landscaped gardens and parks add to the tranquil setting, while a luxury hotel and a high-end mall offer indulgence and convenience. Additional features include a fully operational golf course, helipad, exclusive resorts, and seamless pedestrian connectivity via a scenic bridge, all thoughtfully designed to elevate coastal living into a lifestyle of refined leisure and adventure. The project presents a refined selection of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences, where modern design meets exceptional functionality across three residential towers. Tower C offers fully furnished units, offering a sophisticated turnkey solution with elegant furniture, fitted wardrobes, and kitchens equipped with high-quality white goods for a seamless move-in experience. Interiors are spacious and light-filled, enhanced by thoughtfully curated layouts, en-suite bathrooms, powder rooms, and private balconies that frame serene views of the marina, park, or sea. Comprising four coral-shaped islands, Breeze, Treasure, Dream, and View, it is home to luxury resorts, beach clubs, water sports, and world-class hospitality brands like Rixos, Mövenpick, and DoubleTree. With upcoming landmark developments such as Nobu and the Wynn Resort, Al Marjan Island is rapidly emerging as a premier destination for waterfront living, tourism, and high-return real estate investment, just 45 minutes from Dubai. Its bold yet fluid form is complemented by lush tropical landscaping and flowing water features that embrace a serene promenade. At its core, this development offers a curated lifestyle of wellness and luxury, with world-class amenities such as a state-of-the-art gym, yoga studio, infinity pool, children's pool, padel court, jogging track, family lawn, and scenic garden spaces. Thoughtfully designed terraces and curved balconies frame uninterrupted panoramic sea views and golden sunsets, while tranquil zones like the activity lawn, sunken seating areas, and waterscapes foster relaxation and community. The architectural layout integrates seamlessly with its environment. This destination is just minutes from the upcoming Wynn Resort and key Ras Al Khaimah attractions, positioning it as a prime address for upscale living and future investment. The project presents a refined collection of studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, meticulously designed to blend contemporary luxury with serene coastal living. Each apartment features thoughtfully planned layouts with generous living spaces, high ceilings, and expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the interiors with natural light while offering sweeping views of the sea. Created by Aldar, the project reimagines modern homes as spaces that restore balance, nurture wellbeing, and foster meaningful connections with the natural world. description: Exclusive Beachfront Apartments with Installment on Siniyah Island, Umm Al-Quwain Siniyah Island, located off the coast of Umm Al Quwain in the United Arab Emirates, is a site of significant historical and ecological importance. Archaeological excavations have uncovered the oldest known pearl fishing town in the Persian Gulf on the island, dating back to the late 6th or early 7th century CE. description: Serenz by Danube Properties is an impressive 50-storey residential development designed to redefine contemporary living through an exceptional blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience. Built around the concept of "A World of Amenities," the development brings together modern architecture, thoughtfully designed residences, and an extensive range of lifestyle facilities to create a vibrant residential experience. The project offers fully furnished premium residences featuring contemporary interiors, elegant finishes, and functional layouts. Designed with a modern minimalist approach, the apartments combine style and practicality to create comfortable living spaces. A grand double-height entrance adds to the development's impressive architectural presence, welcoming residents into an environment defined by sophistication and attention to detail. One of Serenz's standout features is its expansive 120,000 sq. ft. of lifestyle amenities, with more than 40 indoor and outdoor facilities. Residents can enjoy a wide range of leisure, wellness, and recreational experiences, including a serenity pool, aqua park, landscaped gardens, fitness zones, sports courts, and spa facilities. The development also features dedicated children's play and daycare areas, a business centre, and social spaces designed to encourage relaxation and community interaction. With its fully furnished residences, extensive lifestyle facilities, and contemporary design, Serenz offers a resort-inspired residential experience where everyday living is complemented by comfort, convenience, and recreation. Location and lifestyle benefits Located in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Serenz enjoys a position within one of Dubai's popular residential communities. Known for its circular layout, landscaped streets, and peaceful neighbourhood atmosphere, JVC offers a balance between urban convenience and relaxed community living. The community features a variety of residential options, including apartments, villas, and townhouses, surrounded by parks and green spaces. Residents benefit from access to everyday essentials such as supermarkets, schools, shopping centres, healthcare facilities, and recreational amenities, making the area suitable for families and working professionals alike. JVC also offers convenient connectivity to Dubai's major road networks, allowing residents to reach key commercial, retail, and leisure destinations across the city. Its combination of community facilities, green surroundings, and urban accessibility makes it an attractive choice for both homeowners and property investors. Serenz brings together the advantages of this established community with an extensive collection of lifestyle amenities, fully furnished homes, and contemporary architecture, offering a distinctive approach to modern residential living.

description: Portside Square is a distinctive waterfront development set within the historic Mina Rashid, where contemporary architecture takes inspiration from the movement and rhythm of the sea. Comprising three sculptural towers - Portside Residences I, II, and III - the development is characterised by fluid lines, soft contours, and shimmering façades that interact beautifully with natural light. Its architectural design creates a harmonious relationship between sea, sky, and structure, offering a refined residential environment with open layouts, expansive glazing, and panoramic views. The development presents a lifestyle centred around wellness, leisure, and social connection. Residents can enjoy leisure and lap pools, landscaped decks, a dedicated fitness pavilion, and spa and sauna facilities. Additional amenities include yoga areas, co-working spaces, cinema and games lounges, and a dedicated children's club, creating an environment that caters to different lifestyles and age groups. Outdoor spaces are thoughtfully integrated throughout the community, with jogging paths, landscaped garden courtyards, and marina-facing lounges offering inviting places to relax, exercise, and connect. The combination of wellness facilities, recreational spaces, and social areas creates a balanced lifestyle with a distinct waterfront character. The residences feature contemporary interiors finished with high-quality materials, natural textures, and refined detailing. Equipped kitchens incorporate premium appliances, combining modern functionality with elegant design. Delivered unfurnished, the homes offer residents the flexibility to personalise their interiors while benefiting from a sophisticated architectural foundation and carefully selected finishes. Location Description & Benefits Dubai Maritime City is a distinctive waterfront destination that combines maritime infrastructure, commercial activity, and emerging residential developments. Strategically positioned near Dubai's established urban districts and major port facilities, the area is evolving into a specialised maritime hub while introducing new opportunities for waterfront living. The district has traditionally supported a wide range of marine-related industries, including shipbuilding, vessel maintenance, marine engineering, and maritime services. Its infrastructure includes specialised shipyards, dry docks, and facilities for marine equipment and service providers, alongside educational and training institutions that support the maritime sector. Its strategic position near Dubai's key ports and transport networks provides important connectivity for maritime businesses and international trade. At the same time, its proximity to the city's established districts allows residents and professionals to benefit from access to commercial centres, retail destinations, dining, and everyday conveniences. As Dubai Maritime City continues to develop, the combination of its waterfront setting, specialised commercial infrastructure, and growing residential offering is creating a distinctive urban environment. It presents an interesting proposition for those seeking a contemporary lifestyle within a developing coastal destination, supported by its strategic position within Dubai.

description: Beachfront Apartments with Post-Handover Payment Plan on Al Marjan Island Al Marjan Island is a stunning man-made archipelago in Ras Al Khaimah, stretching 4.5 kilometers into the Arabian Gulf and offering over 7 kilometers of white-sand beaches and 23 kilometers of waterfront promenade. Comprising four coral-shaped islands, Breeze, Treasure, Dream, and View, it is home to luxury resorts, beach clubs, water sports, and world-class hospitality brands like Rixos, Mövenpick, and DoubleTree. With upcoming landmark developments such as Nobu and the Wynn Resort, Al Marjan Island is rapidly emerging as a premier destination for waterfront living, tourism, and high-return real estate investment, just 45 minutes from Dubai. , are ideally located just 2 minutes from Wynn Resort, 12 minutes from Al Hamra Mall, 13 minutes from RAK Central, 14 minutes from Al Hamra Golf Club, 16 minutes from the Royal Yacht Club of Ras Al Khaimah, 30 minutes from RAK Mall and Al Qawasim Corniche, 35 minutes from RAK International Airport, 50 minutes from Sharjah International Airport, and 60 minutes from Dubai International Airport and Downtown Dubai. The project rises 16 storeys above the Arabian Gulf on Al Marjan Island, designed as a sculptural icon that cascades organically towards the sea, blending architecture with nature to create an exclusive waterfront sanctuary. Its bold yet fluid form is complemented by lush tropical landscaping and flowing water features that embrace a serene promenade. At its core, this development offers a curated lifestyle of wellness and luxury, with world-class amenities such as a state-of-the-art gym, yoga studio, infinity pool, children's pool, padel court, jogging track, family lawn, and scenic garden spaces. Residents are welcomed through a grand arrival drop-off and a striking residential lobby, with direct access to retail outlets at the ground level. Thoughtfully designed terraces and curved balconies frame uninterrupted panoramic sea views and golden sunsets, while tranquil zones like the activity lawn, sunken seating areas, and waterscapes foster relaxation and community. The architectural layout integrates seamlessly with its environment. This destination is just minutes from the upcoming Wynn Resort and key Ras Al Khaimah attractions, positioning it as a prime address for upscale living and future investment. The project presents a refined collection of studio, one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, meticulously designed to blend contemporary luxury with serene coastal living. Each apartment features thoughtfully planned layouts with generous living spaces, high ceilings, and expansive floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the interiors with natural light while offering sweeping views of the sea. The design palette embodies understated elegance, featuring soft neutral tones, premium finishes, and the incorporation of natural materials like stone to create a calm, organic ambiance. Residences come with fully fitted kitchens equipped with high-quality white goods, as well as built-in wardrobes that maximize storage while maintaining sleek, modern aesthetics. Spacious balconies extend the living areas outdoors, enhancing the connection to nature and creating private sanctuaries for relaxation. The interiors are a harmonious balance of functionality and style, crafted to deliver comfort, sophistication, and a lifestyle rooted in both beauty and practicality. RKT-00021

description: Project general facts Sanctuary is a refined residential development set within the prestigious Meydan district, uniquely positioned beside the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary. The project's architecture reflects modern sophistication, with a sculpted façade of glass and clean geometry designed to maximize natural light and panoramic views. Sanctuary offers a rare balance between urban elegance and nature, providing residents with uninterrupted vistas of the Dubai skyline and protected natural landscapes, while remaining minutes from Downtown Dubai and major city arteries. Residents enjoy landscaped serenity gardens, waterfall features, sunken island pools, infinity pools, outdoor fitness areas, kids' pools and play zones, BBQ areas, outdoor cinema, jacuzzi, spa-style relaxation pools, and sky gardens with observation decks. Location description and benefits Ras Al Khor is one of Dubai's hidden gems, where urban convenience meets the untouched beauty of nature. Located just minutes from the city's bustling center, this district is best known for the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary, a protected reserve that is home to thousands of migratory birds, including the iconic pink flamingos. The area's unique charm lies in its serene landscapes, offering residents and visitors a peaceful retreat from the dynamic energy of Dubai while still being well-connected to major landmarks and attractions. Beyond its natural wonders, Ras Al Khor is an emerging residential and commercial hub, offering a blend of modern infrastructure and tranquil surroundings. The district features a mix of upscale developments, spacious villas, and waterfront residences, all designed to provide a harmonious balance between luxury and sustainability. With easy access to Dubai Creek, Downtown Dubai, and major road networks, Ras Al Khor ensures a seamless lifestyle that combines convenience with scenic beauty. As Dubai continues to grow, Ras Al Khor remains a testament to the city's commitment to preserving its natural heritage while embracing modern progress. Future developments in the area promise to enhance its appeal with new residential communities, leisure destinations, and cultural attractions. Whether you are drawn to its stunning wildlife sanctuary, its picturesque waterfront views, or its growing urban landscape, Ras Al Khor offers a unique living experience where nature and city life coexist in perfect harmony.

Its 408 homes range from studios of 396 sq ft to four-bedroom penthouses of 3,441 sq ft, with one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments and two-bedroom units with a study in between.

The Queen Elizabeth 2 is about a minute's drive away, Sheikh Zayed Road six minutes, and Downtown Dubai, Dubai World Trade Centre and Dubai International Airport around 10 minutes.
